ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central and lateral regions, contrasted against 15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels located along the perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white contiguous region. Dark pixel mapping follows the trailing edge and median notch. Distinct circular dark pixel blobs (radiating from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter) are scattered bilaterally, with higher density in the distal upper quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees, with the vertex depth extending significantly toward the peduncle center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 2 to 8 pixels. The pattern is continuous along the trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of over 30 dark circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the white surface; notable clusters are visible in the upper-right distal region and central-left region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions; a prominent vertical-oblique streak is detected in the lower-left quadrant, with secondary shorter horizontal streaks visible in the upper-left and upper-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active colonization of acorn barnacles (high-intensity white/beige clusters) is visible along the distal tips and leading edges; irregular tissue loss and heavy serration on trailing edges consistent with long-term environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly dense cluster of stalked or acorn barnacles is localized specifically on the lateral-most point of the left fluke tip, creating a distinct three-dimensional protrusion from the fluke boundary.
